quote: Each read in R1 includes 0 to 3 bases at the start indicating the "phase" of the read ... The number of phasing bases varies from read to read to increase base diversity for Read 1.
note: v4 phase bases are None/T/GT/TGA per scg_lib_structs (V4.0 section, https://teichlab.github.io/scg_lib_structs/methods_html/PIP-seq.html (raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Teichlab/scg_lib_structs/master/methods_html/PIP-seq.html)); no source gives the v5 phase sequences. DRAGEN: --scrna-num-barcode-phases=4.

quote: a barcode sequence with 4 tiers ... Each barcode tier is composed of 96 possible sequences, allowing 96^4 total barcode combinations. By default, the barcode positions are set to 0_7+11_16+20_25+31_38.
note: Positions are 0-based inclusive, counted after the phase bases (DRAGEN figure puts 0 under the first tier-1 base): https://400428970-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2FS6tWlZO1JqcbWYgnhR2X%2Fuploads%2Fgit-blob-80187f9a36d5a7127fde01ea4c451ace67340bd7%2FPIPseq_barcode_structure.png?alt=media

v3/v4 linker here is ATG (scg_lib_structs). No v5/Illumina source gives the sequence; Fluent V guides' Appendix II lists no bead oligo (https://crtp.ccr.cancer.gov/wp-content/uploads/fsgc-protocols/PIPseq-V-T2-3-Single-Cell-RNA-Kit-User-Guide-1-4.pdf).

quote: followed by a 3-base binning index (BI) sequence ... By default, the UMI positions are set to 39_41. ... Note that the binning index position is set using the --scrna-umi-position option. ... IMIs are grouped in one of 64 bins, based on the 3-base binning index.
note: There is no UMI. Molecules are counted by intrinsic molecular identifiers (IMIs: R2 alignment start after random fragmentation) within the 64 BI bins. Preprint Fig 7A: '3N base binning index'. KB 9448: 'Intrinsic Molecular Identifiers rather than UMIs' (http://web.archive.org/web/20260515105303/https://knowledge.illumina.com/library-preparation/illumina-single-cell-rna-prep/library-preparation-illumina-single-cell-rna-prep-reference_material-list/000009448).

quote: Fig 7A legend: 'PIPseq V core particles with oligonucleotide sequences carrying 5' PCR handle, cellular barcodes, 3N base binning index, ACG spacer, and poly A mRNA capture moiety.' Figure box: 'BI + Spacer NNNACG' (https://www.biorxiv.org/content/biorxiv/early/2024/10/05/2024.10.04.616561/F7.large.jpg). Methods: 'a 3-base binning index, a fixed spacer sequence, and a poly(dT)V capture site'.
note: Not in DRAGEN's positions or figure, and not in KB 9449's library figure (Barcodes 42-45 then 30Poly(dT)V). Consistent with the training packet: 'limited base diversity of Read 1 starting at cycle 46 (poly A region)' = 0-based 45 at phase 0 (https://support.illumina.com/content/dam/illumina-support/courses/illumina-single-cell-3-rna-prep-training-packet/illumina-single-cell-3-rna-prep-training-packet-200065159-01.pdf). Confirm on the design run.

quote: Library figure: '42-45 Barcodes' then '31 30Poly(dT)V'; 'Read 1 contains barcode information and must be sequenced > 45 bases.'
note: With Illumina's 45+10+10+72 recipe R1 ends inside BI/spacer: phase 3 ends at the BI, phase 0 shows ACG and no T. polyT is visible only on longer R1 (e.g. 2x150 runs).

quote: Read 1 length must be ≥ 45 bases and the recommended Read 2 length ≥ 72 bases.
note: Same sentence on the T10, T20 and T100 guides (https://support-docs.illumina.com/LP/PIPseqT10/Content/LP/PIPseq/Introduction_RNA.htm ; https://support-docs.illumina.com/LP/PIPseqT20/Content/LP/PIPseq/Introduction_RNA.htm ; https://support-docs.illumina.com/LP/PIPseqT100/Content/LP/PIPseq/Introduction_RNA.htm). Preprint Methods: 'v4.0PLUS and UCP libraries utilize a 54-base Read 1 ... PIPseq V (IMI) libraries differ with a shorter 45-base R1' (https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.10.04.616561v1.full). 3+39+12=54 and 3+39+3=45.

quote: R2 includes the sequenced cDNA constructs ... In addition, the first base, a constant T, is removed from the 5' end of R2. ... TSO sequences are removed from the 5' end and poly-A sequences are removed from the 3' end in the R2 FASTQ file.
note: DRAGEN default --rna-library-type SF (forward). Fluent V Appendix II: ligation adapter TATAAGAGACAGT, TSO AAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGTGAATrGrGrG (https://crtp.ccr.cancer.gov/wp-content/uploads/fsgc-protocols/PIPseq-V-T2-3-Single-Cell-RNA-Kit-User-Guide-1-4.pdf).

quote: The libraries are dual-indexed with 10-base i5 and i7 indexes.
note: v3 used 8-base indexes per scg_lib_structs; preprint: v4.0PLUS uses "optional 8 or 10 base indexes". Not in the FASTQ pair.

quote: Training packet lists Illumina Single Cell 3' RNA Prep T2, T10, T20, T100 products; all four user guides give the same read structure statement.
note: No source shows any size-specific read structure. DRAGEN uses one setting for all.
